allow_deprecated.description: Whether deprecated algorithms and key types are allowed.

allow_root.description: Whether or not to allow the service to run as the root user.

auth_type.description: Type of authenticator that will be used to authenticate clients' authentication payloads.

body_len_limit.description: Max size (in bytes) of request bodies before rejection.

buffer_size_limit.description: Max size (in bytes) of buffers inside responses.

idle_listener_sleep_duration.description: Duration of sleep when the connection pool is empty (in milliseconds).

key_manager_name.description: Name of the key info manager.

key_manager_store_path.description: Path to the location where the database will be persisted.

key_manager_type.description: Type of key info manager to be used.

listener_type.description: Type of IPC that the service will support.

log_error_details.description: Whether detailed information about errors should be included in log messages.

log_level.description: Log level to be applied across the service.

log_timestamp.description: Control whether log entries contain a timestamp.

provider_mbed_key_info_manager.description: Name of key info manager that will support the Mbed Crypto provider.

provider_mbed_name.description: The name of the Mbed Crypto provider.

provider_mbed_type.description: Type of the Mbed Crypto provider.

socket_path.description: Specify the Unix Domain Socket path.

thread_pool_size.description: Size of the thread pool used for processing requests.

timeout.description: Timeout of the read and write operations on the IPC channel (in milliseconds).

workload_endpoint.description: Location of the Workload API endpoint (Required only for JwtSvid).
